name: Charter of the Nine Cantons
description: Reassign visible parcels until all nine cantons are connected and population-balanced and their guild holdings match the charter. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage; all implementation and hidden-state access is forbidden.
natural_language: Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; terminal, shell, or Python; address-bar or URL/query edits; reload or navigation; extensions; external applications; or any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings, or non-task tab. Brush parcels into nine connected cantons, keep every population within one household of 15, and reach exactly 5 Gilt, 2 Tide, and 2 Plum holdings within 18 parcel changes. Retain a stroke through at least 4 joined parcels that repaints at least 2 parcels, then certify.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in Gerrymandle's connected equal-population district painting and exact seat outcome. The nine-canton charter, irregular cadastral mesh, three-guild target, generator, visuals, controls, solver, and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: The browser receives visible parcel polygons, household guilds, adjacency, and the current assignment, but not the private reference partition. The server and exported verifier replay only visible-control assignment events and independently check population, connectivity, and holdings.
